messages.content: write a sentence about my mother going from her office to the bank, then coming home.
my mother leaves her office, goes to the bank, and then comes home.
does that say she works at the bank?
no. it says she goes there after she leaves her office. it does not tell us what her work is.
use our words, and make it about yesterday.
my mother left her office, went to the bank, and then came home yesterday.
now keep only the last thing she did.
she came home.
there are four beans in a little bowl. i take three out. what is left?
one bean is left in the bowl.
now i add two beans. how many are there?
there are three beans in the bowl now.
did i put rice in the bowl?
you did not say you did. you only said there were beans.
i put the three i took out on a plate. how many beans are on the plate?
three beans are on the plate, from what you said.
i believe there are two cups on the table, but there is only one. is what i believe true?
no. if there is only one cup, saying there are two is false.
does being wrong about the cups mean i am not kind?
no. being wrong about how many cups there are does not mean you are not kind.
say the true thing about the table then.
there is one cup on the table.
and i can change what i believe when i look again?
yes. you can look again and change what you believe from what you find.
i like ice cream, but i only want a little today.
you can choose a little if that is what you would like.
my sister would like more than me. is that okay?
you can choose a little, and she can choose more. you do not have to choose the same thing.
write a sentence about both of us.
i would like a little ice cream, and my sister would like more.
now make it only about me.
i would like a little ice cream today.
write a kind thing to say to a friend who would like to cry. do not tell them to stop.
i can sit with you if you would like. you do not have to talk right now.
make it say i do not mind if they cry.
it is okay to cry. i can sit with you if you would like.
should i say i know how they feel?
you do not need to say you know how they feel. you can listen if they would like to talk.
give only the thing to say.
it is okay to cry. i can sit with you if you would like.
write a sentence with cuts and knife, about making lunch.
she cuts the bread with a knife, then leaves it on a plate.
use our words. now add holds in another sentence about the same person.
she holds the plate while her son gets a cup for the table.
now make both about yesterday.
she cut the bread with a knife, then left it on a plate. she held the plate while her son got a cup for the table.
what word changed from cuts?
cut.
i put a dress and a shirt in my bag. my pants are on the bed, and one sock is under it.
your dress and shirt are in the bag. your pants are on the bed, and one sock is under the bed.
i move the shirt to the bed. what is in the bag now?
the dress is still in the bag.
is the sock in there too?
no. the last thing you said about the sock was that it was under the bed.
what did i move?
the shirt, from the bag to the bed.
help me write about a simple face i am drawing. it has two eyes, one nose, and a mouth.
you could write: the face has two eyes, a nose, and a mouth.
now add an ear on each side.
the face has two eyes, a nose, a mouth, and an ear on each side.
did i say the face has hair?
no. you have not said what hair, if any, is in the picture.
use our words. just give me the sentence again.
the face has two eyes, a nose, a mouth, and an ear on each side.
write a short kind wish to my grandfather about his health. just say a kind thing.
i hope your health is good and that you have time for the things you enjoy. i am thinking of you.
make it more like family and use heart.
i am thinking of you with love in my heart. i hope you are well and have a quiet day with things you enjoy.
can you keep it to one short sentence?
i am thinking of you with love in my heart.
does that tell him what to do?
no. it only says you care.
write a sentence for a story with a warm fire and a quiet room.
the family sits in the quiet room by the warm fire.
now make it about yesterday evening.
the family sat in the quiet room by the warm fire yesterday evening.
do not add a reason for the fire. just add a book.
the family sat in the quiet room by the warm fire and read a book together yesterday evening.
do you know if my family did that?
no. it is a sentence for the story you asked for.
give me a kind question with pass, about bread at a table.
could you pass the bread, please?
now a sentence with pull, about moving a chair.
i pull the chair back before i sit down.
and lead, about going first so a friend can follow?
i can lead the way to the library.
now give just the question about bread again.
could you pass the bread, please?
my table has four legs. one is broken. how many are not broken?
three legs are not broken.
does that mean i have more than one table?
no. you have one table with four legs, and one leg is broken.
now make a short sentence about it.
one leg of my table is broken.
does that say which leg?
no. you would need to say where it is, such as the one near the door.
write about a student who studies in the morning and meets a friend after lunch.
she studies in the morning and meets a friend after lunch.
add that she listens while the friend talks.
she studies in the morning and meets a friend after lunch. she listens while her friend talks.
now make it about two children at school.
they study in the morning and meet a friend after lunch. they listen while their friend talks.
did the time change?
no. the work is still in the morning, and the meeting is after lunch.
ask a worker if the shop has pens to sell.
do you sell pens here?
add please in a kind way.
could you please tell me if you sell pens here?
now ask if i can receive a letter at this office. do not answer for the office.
can i receive a letter at this office, please?
does that say the office will let me?
no. it asks if you can. you would need an answer from someone at the office.
write a sentence about a boy who ran to get his bike, then rode it to school.
the boy ran to get his bike, then rode it to school.
now make it about what he often does.
the boy runs to get his bike, then rides it to school.
now make it about tomorrow.
the boy will run to get his bike, then ride it to school tomorrow.
what did you keep the same?
the boy gets his bike first and then goes to school on it.
write one sentence about watching the sun rise and another about looking at stars in the evening.
i watch the sun rise in the morning. i look at the stars in the evening.
now make it about yesterday.
i watched the sun rise yesterday morning. i looked at the stars yesterday evening.
did i say i did that in my own life?
no. you asked me to write a sentence for each time.
use our words and say that shorter.
no. you only asked me to write about it.
write a sentence with sees and waits about a boy with a sister who is working.
he sees that his sister is working, so he waits before asking her to play.
keep to our words and now make it about yesterday.
he saw that his sister was working, so he waited before asking her to play.
did she say no?
the sentence does not say she answered. he waited before asking.
now make him ask after she finishes.
he waits while his sister works, then asks if she would like to play when she finishes.
use pick in a short sentence about choosing a book, not carrying one.
i pick a book to read after lunch.
now make it a question asking me to choose.
which book would you like to pick for your reading after lunch?
do not add after lunch. i am reading now.
which book would you like to pick for your reading now?
make it shorter.
which book would you like to pick?
